note: Iowa DNR park in the Loess Hills on the north-west edge of Sioux City. One small wooded campground: 8 electric and 4 non-electric back-in sites of 30-42 ft for RVs, the rest tent-only, plus a youth-group site and three camping cabins; modern restroom and shower building, water hydrants, no dump station. CCC-built lodge and shelters; 15 miles of hiking, mountain-bike and multi-use trails; the Dorothy Pecaut Nature Center (Woodbury County) is next door. No daily Iowa park-entry fee. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica parkId 610117 confirmed as Stone. 12 RV sites (8 electric 30-42 ft, 4 non-electric 30-35 ft; no pull-throughs), 50A at 3 sites, showers/flush + pit latrines, NO dump station on the DNR map or amenities; 100% reservable. Fees $10/$14 (non-electric, which fit 23 ft) confirmed on RA. Season (manual) Apr 15-Oct 31 matches RA; not written. Not waterfront kept. Pin possibly ~410 m off but the loop isn't visible under canopy. Note rewritten.
flags: FIT: fits. All 12 RV sites take 30 ft or more (electric 005-012 30-42 ft, non-electric 001-004 30-35 ft, all back-ins); the 15 tent-only sites (12-30 ft) and the walk-to site are not RV sites. The old note's 'Big-rig choices are limited - confirm a fitting site for a 23-ft rig' is not supported for a 23-ft motorhome and was dropped.

SITES: count was unset (old note said '~10 standard electric'); 12 written. The DNR map marks site 13 as Electric (20/30-amp) ADA, but ReserveAmerica lists 013 as 'Tent Only' 21 ft, so 13 is not counted.

DUMP / SEASON NOTE: neither the DNR park page's amenity list nor the 12/2025 campground map shows a dump station (Pine Lake's page, by contrast, lists 'Dump station'), so dump:false is written. The stored manual season note says 'the dump station closes for the winter', which looks like it came from the DNR's statewide winterizing release; it can't be overwritten here. Suggest dropping that clause from season.note.
SEASON: manual 04-15 to 10-31 matches ReserveAmerica ('closed each year from November 1 - April 14'; Off Peak April 15-30 and October 16-31). Not written.
FEES: confirmed on ReserveAmerica 2027: non-electric $10 off-peak / $14 peak, electric $18 / $22. The non-electric sites are 30-35 ft, so $10 is a real base for a 23-ft motorhome. No change.

PIN (unconfirmed, possibly ~410 m off): stored 42.55560,-96.46520 is in closed canopy south of the campground road; Google's 'Stone State Park Campground and Lodge' sits at 42.5587966,-96.4677469, ~410 m NNW. ReserveAmerica gives no per-site coordinates for this park and the loop can't be matched to the map on imagery, so no corrected pin is offered; Google's point is a lead only.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. ReserveAmerica tags all 30 campsites 'Near Water - no'; the campground is on the wooded Loess Hills ridges with the Big Sioux River ~1.3 km west below the bluffs (imagery estimate; Overpass unavailable).

CLOSURE (seasonal, no status): DNR alerts say the modern restrooms and water were shut off for the season (10/16/2026, reopening April 15, 2027; pit latrines at the campground stay open) and the park roads closed for the season on 11/2/2026. Matches the closed season; nothing to write.
